description.value: The First Dessert is a locally owned Cantonese dessert shop on Victoria Drive specializing in traditional and modernized Chinese sweets, with 50+ items including ginger milk, mango sago, and taro coconut milk. The shop blends Hong Kong-style dessert culture with a relaxed dine-in atmosphere and multi-lingual service. Takeout and third-party delivery are also available, making it a convenient stop for a sweet break.
